t: Enhancing AI Prompts with XML Tags: Testing Anthropic's Method and o4-mini-high
s: This article explores structuring LLM prompts with XML-like tags, as proposed by Anthropic, to improve AI understanding. The author applies this to a Python tool 'prompt_foo.py' for enhancing AI analysis of a web app project 'Pipulate', testing the method with the 'o4-mini-high' model.
sub: LLM context generation for code analysis
